title: TRICARE Prime Credit for Months Not After the Disenrollment Month
content:
In a TRICARE Prime proration credit, a counted month that is not after the month containing the disenrollment date is credited instead by how soon the beneficiary's TRICARE Select enrollment took effect after the Prime disenrollment date:

| TRICARE Select took effect | Such a counted month is credited at |
|---|---|
| the day after the disenrollment date (1 day after) | the full value of a counted month |
| two to fifteen days after it (2 to 15 days) | half that value, rounded to the cent |
| otherwise | nothing |

Days are calendar days from the Prime disenrollment date to the TRICARE Select effective date.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, Prime disenrollment date 20 July, value of a counted month 65.02)

| TRICARE Select effective | Days after | Credit for such a month |
|---|---|---|
| 21 July | 1 | 65.02 |
| 22 July | 2 | 32.51 |
| 4 August | 15 | 32.51 |
| 5 August | 16 | nothing |
| no TRICARE Select enrollment | - | nothing |
